scope: Standalone temporary-file reproduction only; no active result files were read and no API calls were made.
observations: os.replace succeeded when the destination had no open reader.
os.replace and direct MoveFileExW failed with WinError 5 when a destination reader was open, even with CreateFileW sharing flags FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE (7).
ReplaceFileW succeeded with the shared-delete destination reader open; the old handle read the old snapshot and a newly opened path read the replacement.
interpretation: Shared-delete reader flags alone did not solve the current os.replace writer race on this Windows environment. This reproduction establishes a compatible failure mechanism; it does not prove which process held the original pilot file.
status_change: status.py reads batch_manifest.json and completed summary.json files only. It never opens active progress.json, checkpoint.json, or api_calls.jsonl. Reported cost and completion explicitly exclude unfinished episodes.
writer_followup: Parent will add bounded PermissionError retries after the frozen pilot ends; no scm source was changed by this check.
